I also conduct discovery, present solutions and coordinate proposals and technical next steps.

My contribution connects process design, day-to-day execution and continuous improvement. Technical architecture and delivery are aligned with the relevant specialists.

MARKETING ALIGNMENT & DEMAND GENERATION

From the right audience
to a qualified conversation.

My experience includes qualifying inbound and outbound leads, planning targeted outreach and organizing follow-up. I connect segmentation, relevant messaging and CRM context to the commercial next step.

OUTBOUND

Build a relevant starting point

Define ideal customer criteria, segment accounts, identify relevant roles and research a hypothesis before contacting someone.

  • Account research and contact qualification
  • Personalized multichannel outreach
  • Response handling and contextual follow-up
INBOUND

Qualify the interest already expressed

Understand the source and context of an inquiry, assess fit and clarify the business need before arranging discovery.

  • Context from the original inquiry
  • Qualification and prioritization
  • CRM history and agreed next action
Where marketing connects

Audience segmentation, a clear value proposition, campaign messaging and feedback from sales conversations. I use feedback from qualification to refine targeting and messaging.

PRE-SALES & SOLUTION DEMONSTRATIONS

Make the solution relevant.
Make the next step clear.

BEFORE THE DEMO

Prepare the discussion

Understand the audience, select suitable examples and align the demonstration objective and readiness with technical colleagues.

DURING THE DISCUSSION

Tell the business story

Explain the problem, solution approach and potential application. Ask questions and distinguish a generic example from the customer's confirmed requirements.

AFTER DISCOVERY

Translate questions into action

Document requirements, unresolved questions and evaluation criteria. Coordinate a technical session, a scoped demo or a proposal when appropriate.

The interactive examples in this portfolio demonstrate my process thinking with synthetic data. They are not employer products or client implementations.

Contact / CompanyRoleDriver hypothesisStatus

Relevant outreach, with a clear next step.

This example cadence uses fictional messages. Replying automatically pauses subsequent touches. A human then decides how to continue.

TOUCH 1 · LINKEDIN

Connect with context

Check the person’s role and relevance before starting a conversation.

TOUCH 2 · EMAIL

Introduce a hypothesis

Connect a business responsibility to a possible use case, without assuming a need.

TOUCH 3 · WHATSAPP

Follow up thoughtfully

Use only an appropriate, permitted contact channel. Preserve context across touches.

AFTER A REPLY

Pause and qualify

Stop automated outreach, record intent and create the next task.

Workflow rules demonstrated

  • A contact is counted once in reach, even across multiple channels.
  • Each outreach activity is counted separately.
  • A reply pauses the cadence and preserves the conversation history.
  • A driver is an outreach hypothesis, not a confirmed customer need.
